test_title: PYST 80: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
The given bar graph shows the turnover of five companies (in crores).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e79d49781ae9bbc91f308cbc5edc9fa25d9868ae44f7ff71c1447801cec390fc.png] 

What is the difference between the average sales turnover of all the companies put together between the years 2018-2019 and 2019-2020?
solution:
Calculation:

The average sales turnover of all the companies put together between the years 2018-2019 in crore

⇒ (250 + 350 + 275 + 200 + 400)/5

⇒ 295

The average sales turnover of all the companies put together between the years 2019-2020 in crore

⇒ (300 + 250 + 300 + 300 + 350)/5

⇒ 300

According to the question, 

⇒ 300 - 295

⇒ 5

**∴ The difference between the average sales turnover of all the companies put together between the years 2018-2019 and 2019-2020 is 5.**
